description: This file defines mock functions, constants, and includes for unit testing device-related APIs in a C project. It provides declarations for retrieving device information such as account ID, model number, manufacturer name, build type, firmware version, eSTB MAC address, and partner ID, along with a function to check for running instances.

methods.name: GetAccountID
methods.description: Retrieves the device's account ID into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetModelNum
methods.description: Retrieves the device's model number into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetMFRName
methods.description: Retrieves the device's manufacturer name into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetBuildType
methods.description: Retrieves the build type of the device in lowercase, optionally returning an enum indicating the build type.

methods.name: GetFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the eSTB MAC address into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: GetPartnerId
methods.description: Retrieves the partner ID into a provided buffer, returning the number of characters copied.

methods.name: CurrentRunningInst
methods.description: Checks if an instance of a service is currently running based on a lock file.

methods.name: stripinvalidchar
methods.description: Removes invalid characters from an input string, returning the number of characters processed.
